description: How platform pages are placed inside a template. Every platform page (donate, services, events, campaigns, the members area) renders through a fixed set of LAYOUT INTENTS — the content SEAM. A template STYLES these intents to place content its way; it must never build a parallel content container, or platform pages drift from the template's own sections. Enforced at publish by the conformance validator.

intents.note: The contained content column — text, forms, cards. Style it (and override --container) to set your content width and gutter. Use it in your own layout and sections too, so everything shares one column.
Edge-to-edge regardless of the container it sits in — a hero image, a colour band. Restyle it freely; the default breaks out to the viewport width.

rules.message: builds its own content container from var(--container). Platform pages render inside .container, so a parallel container drifts from your sections — style .container instead (override --container for width and add your gutter there), and use .full for edge-to-edge.
